channel.title: Microsoft SOC Brief
channel.description: Due within 7 days, new since the last brief, Microsoft changes in Graph and roles

item.title: [Due in 3 days] SSPR requires registered authentication methods
[Due in 3 days] Windows App adds three client-side wildcard domains for Windows 365
[Due in 3 days] User-managed sync file exclusions and .db-wal default exclusion
item.description: M365 admin · Due in 3 days · deadline 2026-10-05

item.title: [New] EWS needs an EWSAllowedAppIDs allow list from 10 October; EWSEnabled=True alone stops being enough
[New] SharePoint one-time passcode retirement slips: Phase 2 now starts mid-October and runs to the end of November
[New] Passkeys for B2B guests: a resource tenant will issue its own passkeys to guest users, on by default
[New] The deployment map gains MS-ConnectSyncBlocked.ReadWrite.All on the legacy Azure AD Graph resource and two hidden PrintBadges scopes
[New] Defender Antivirus platform 4.18.26080.4 is documented: it fixes the false "Microsoft Defender Antivirus is turned off" notification
[New] Entra App Gallery gets self-service onboarding for publishers: preview now, general availability from mid-November
[New] AI Builder capacity add-ons retire on 1 November; existing credits last to the end of the subscription term
[Graph: Changed permission] EntraBackup.Read.All
item.description: DisplayText "Read Entra Backup configuration, preview jobs, and snapshots"; Allows the app to read the Entra Backup configuration, list snapshots and jobs, and enumerate the changes of a specific preview job. Endpoint added: GET /directory/recovery/configuration.

item.title: [Graph: New permission] LifecyclePolicies-AgentId.Read.All
item.description: Entered permissions/new/permissions.json in the Weekly Permissions sync of 25 September 2026, commit fa788f1. Microsoft publishes it as “Read identity lifecycle policies for agent identities” on Application and DelegatedWork, admin consent required, privilege level 3. Not yet on the public permissions reference, which stands at commit 47f6520 of 4 August 2026.

item.title: [Graph: New permission] LifecyclePolicies-AgentId.ReadWrite.All
item.description: Entered permissions/new/permissions.json in the Weekly Permissions sync of 25 September 2026, commit fa788f1. Microsoft publishes it as “Read and write identity lifecycle policies for agent identities” on Application and DelegatedWork, admin consent required, privilege level 3. Not yet on the public permissions reference, which stands at commit 47f6520 of 4 August 2026.
